story.title: The Pain Collector
story.logline: A woman whose touch absorbs physical agony realizes her own body was never hers to begin with.
story.twist: The pain she has spent a lifetime absorbing is actually the future suffering of her own unborn child.
story.ending: How many times can you break the same heart before it stops beating?

scenes.narration: Your pain doesn't vanish into thin air. It packs its bags and moves right into my bones.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, grimacing as she touches a crying man's arm in a dim, cluttered alley.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up to medium shot, tracking forward rapidly

scenes.narration: People pay me fortunes to take their broken bones, their burning fevers, and their relentless migraines away.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, in the same dim alley, counting a thick stack of wet cash with trembling, bruised fingers.

scenes.narration: I am the human sponge. Every ache finds a home inside my chest, screaming until I sleep.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, collapsing onto a narrow cot in a cramped, concrete-walled room.

scenes.narration: Tonight, a stranger hands me a glowing blue vial of agony so pure it makes my teeth ache.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, staring wide-eyed at a glowing neon-blue liquid in a glass vial held by a gloved hand.
scenes.camera: Tight focus on the vial, shallow depth of field

scenes.narration: I press it against my palm. The fire spreads up my arm, devouring every nerve in my body.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, arching her back in agony as blue light surges through her veins.

scenes.narration: As the white-hot flash fades, a voice whispers from the dark, calling a name I've never heard.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, panting heavily in the dark room, turning her head toward a glowing digital monitor.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in on her terrified eyes

scenes.narration: The screen flashes my medical file. But the patient ID belongs to an infant born twenty years from now.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, staring at a holographic medical chart showing a baby's heartbeat.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot focusing on the screen

scenes.narration: Every agony I healed, every broken bone I took away, they weren't random gifts of mercy at all.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, touching her own flat stomach with trembling, bloodstained hands.

scenes.narration: I wasn't saving strangers from their suffering. I was building a lifetime of torture for my own child.
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, weeping silently as blue veins pulse beneath her skin in a heartbeat pattern.

scenes.narration: How many times can you break the same heart before it stops beating?
scenes.visual_prompt: Elena, 25, messy dark hair, wearing a worn gray hoodie, looking directly into the camera lens with a tear rolling down her cheek as the lights flicker out.

caption.hook: Every touch absorbed her own unborn future.
caption.title: The Pain Collector
caption.caption: She thought she was healing the world by taking their agony into her own flesh. But as the final truth unravels, she realizes every scar belongs to the child she hasn't had yet. Would you trade your future to save the present?
